content.title: How many majors has Rory McIlroy won? See full list of historic wins
content.text: April 10, 2026Updated April 12, 2026, 6:56 p.m. ETRory McIlroy has gone back-to-back at the Masters.His 12-under par 276 was good enough to hold off Scottie Scheffler by a stroke to claim his sixth career major.McIlroy completed the career Grand Slam last year with his Masters victory, a feat more than a decade in the making.Here's a look back at all the majors—six of them to be exact—for one of golf's growing legends.How many majors has Rory McIlroy won?McIlroy now has six major titles to his name after the 2026 Masters, winning majors in consecutive years after not winning a major since since the PGA Championship and Open Championship in 2014.McIlroy also has wins at the 2011 U.S. Open and the 2012 PGA Championship.See how he won them.Rory McIlroy wins 2011 U.S. OpenAt Congressional Country Club in Bethesda, Maryland, McIlroy lapped the field with a 16-under par 268, doubling Jason Day's 8-under score. McIlroy shot under 70 in all four rounds. McIlroy led wire-to-wire and set a U.S. Open record for lowest score to par. The win came just two months after the collapse at the Masters.2012 PGA ChampionshipAt Kiawah Island, South Carolina, McIlroy stormed to the lead in the third round with a 5-under par 67 before a 66 in the final round sealed the tournament.His 13-under total again ran away from the field, winning by eight shots over David Lynn.2014 Open ChampionshipAt Royal Liverpool, McIlroy's 17-under par 271 beat Rickie Fowler and Sergio Garcia by two strokes despite a 1-under par final round 71. A pair of 66's and a 68 in the first three rounds gave him a six-shot lead over Rickie Fowler going into the final round.2014 PGA ChampionshipAt Valhalla Country Club in Louisville, Kentucky, McIlroy took control in the second round for a lead he wouldn't relinquish.McIlroy's 16-under par edged 268 edged Phil Mickelson by a stroke and Fowler and Henrik Stenson by two strokes.2025 MastersMcIlroy birdied the 18th hole in a playoff to defeat Justin Rose.McIlroy held a 5-shot lead on the 13th hole, but struggled at times coming in, including a bogey on the 18th hole that forced the playoff.But unlike other times in his career, he took this one.2026 MastersMcIlroy had to hold on after jumping out to the largest 36-hole lead in Masters history. McIlroy held the lead or co-lead after every round, but his six-shot lead evaporated after a 1-over par 73 on Saturday.His 1-par 71 on Sunday won his second green jacket.Rory McIlroy's Masters Champions Dinner MenuMcIlroy served a first course of Yellowfin Tuna Carpaccio with Foie Gras, Toasted Baguette and Chives before getting to the main course choices of Wagyu Filet Mignon or Seared Salmon, with Traditional Irish Champ, Sauteed Brussels Sprouts, Glazed Carrots with Brown Butter and Crispy Vidalia Onion Rings.Irish champ is a creamy mashed potato dish with scallions, butter and milk.Before those courses, McIlroy offered appetizers of Peach & Riccotta Flatbread (with balsamic, hot honey and basil), Rock Shrimp Tempura (with creamy spicy sauce), Bacon-Wrapped Dates (with goat cheese and almonds) and Grilled Elk Sliders (with caramelized onion jam and roasted garlic aioli).For dessert: Sticky Toffee Pudding (with vanilla ice cream and warm toffee sauce).Ryne Dennis is the Deep South Connect Team Editor for Gannett/USA Today and former sports editor in USA TODAY and the Athens Banner-Herald.
